messages:
elaine-cs: Hey @here, NorthStar Health (Sam) just flagged a SIG/CAIQ due in 48h and they're blocked — their audit export for KMS/key usage is failing with intermittent 503s and a 401 on keystore export. Sam says NDA is signed. Can eng + security advise?

sam-northstar: Hi team. We ran the export via UI and via API. UI shows 'Export failed: temporary service outage (503)'. API attempt with our service token returned 401 for /keystore/export then succeeded on a retry. Auditors require HSM attestation + audit log snapshot. Due Friday EOD. Need a packaged evidence bundle and notes on token rotation.

matt-eng: Thanks Sam. Can you paste the request_id(s) from the UI fail and the exact curl you used for the API attempt?

sam-northstar: Request IDs: req_20260316_aa12, req_20260316_ab34. Curl we used: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer svc-prod-xxxx' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keystore/export -d '{"range":"2025-01-01/2026-03-16"}' -v
```

elaine-cs: Note: their service token rotates weekly — could explain the 401.

matt-eng: I see 503s in our telemetry around 2026-03-16T22:14:03Z in us-east-1. Also need the X-Redwood-Trace or x-request-id header if available. For repro: (1) use a fresh service token, (2) POST same body to /keystore/export, (3) set header X-Redwood-Debug: export, (4) capture x-request-id from response.

sam-northstar: Trying now...

sam-northstar: Logs we captured:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 22:14:04 GMT
x-request-id: req_20260316_aa12
www-authenticate: Bearer error=\"invalid_token\", error_description=\"rotated credential\"

HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 22:14:05 GMT
x-request-id: req_20260316_ab34
retry-after: 3
```

matt-eng: That matches what I see — a rotated token (401) then a transient export worker backlog (503). @infra-oncall can you check export-consumer queue/worker scaling around 22:12-22:18 UTC for us-east-1? req ids above.

infra-oncall: On it. Initial check shows an autoscale delay: export-consumer pool didn't scale fast enough during a burst. Increasing worker count and restarting export-consumer-2. Will report back in ~10m.

security-bot: NOTE: HSM attestation/evidence request logged as ticket REDWOOD-SEC-4312. Please attach approval email thread for access.

ravi-security: For SIG items we can provide: KMS usage logs (CSV), audit-log snapshot, HSM attestation PDF (vendor cert), and a signed statement describing our token rotation window. We cannot share private keys. With NDA in place we can upload artifacts to a secure bucket. Security turnaround estimate ~24h after approval.

sam-northstar: NDA is in place. Please include the keystore-export manifest and checksums. Also include a note about rotation window to explain the 401.

elaine-cs: I'll request a 48h due-date extension with the customer. @sam-northstar OK to move SIG due to Monday EOD?

sam-northstar: Monday EOD works for us, thanks.

matt-eng: Infra reports worker pool fixed; re-run of the export should succeed. If you still see 503, set header X-Redwood-Retry: true and use exponential backoff. To avoid 401, create a fresh short-lived service token via Console -> Service Tokens (role: export-read) and use that for the export run.

sam-northstar: Re-ran with the fresh token — export returned 200 and provided a download link. Downloading artifacts now. Thanks.

ravi-security: We'll prepare and upload these artifacts: (1) export manifest + checksums, (2) KMS usage logs CSV, (3) HSM attestation PDF, (4) signed rotation statement. Expect secure S3 link in ~4h. Tagging @elaine-cs for delivery note.

elaine-cs: Great. I'll confirm with the customer once artifacts are uploaded and keep the SIG thread updated.

sam-northstar: Received the link and the HSM attestation PDF — auditors are satisfied with the certificate and the rotation note. Closing on our side. :tada:

matt-eng: Thanks everyone — filing postmortem notes into RED-INC-2026-140 about export scaling and adding a guard to pre-warm export-consumers when large exports queued.

elaine-cs: Closing this thread — follow-ups in REDWOOD-SEC-4312 and RED-INC-2026-140.
